services.name: Dolphin Tours
services.desc: Depart from Waterline Marina in Holmes Beach for a 2-hour cruise around Anna Maria Island, with options for both private family charters and public group tours. Glide through the calm back bay and out toward the Gulf Coast, where pods of bottlenose dolphins regularly surface alongside the boat. Watch for grazing manatees on the shallow grass flats during the warmer months, plus sea turtles, eagles, and osprey along the way. Your captain knows where the wildlife gathers, so every cruise ends with the kind of close encounters and photos that keep guests coming back year after year. services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: Climb aboard our 30-foot, two-story tiki boat at Waterline Marina in Holmes Beach for a 3 or 4 hour private charter built for celebrations. Up to 12 guests cruise the back bay and Gulf with a Bluetooth sound system, plenty of shade, and a built-in waterslide. Drop into the water from the slide at quiet sandbars, dance to your own playlist, and watch for dolphins, manatees, and exotic birds along the way. Whether it’s a birthday, bachelorette, or just a day worth marking, your captain handles the route while the party handles the fun. The Tiki is an awesome 30-foot, two-story party boat with a slide. Our private pontoon boat tour guarantees a great time, featuring a Bluetooth sound system

services.name: Pontoon Boat Rentals
services.desc: Reserve a 24-foot pontoon boat from Waterline Marina in Holmes Beach for a half-day or full-day rental, and take Anna Maria Island on at your own pace. Cruise the Gulf, the back bay, or the inland waters with up to 10 people aboard, fuel included. Drop anchor at a quiet sandbar, hunt for dolphins along the grass flats, or beach-hop your way around the island for lunch and swimming. The 24-foot deck features a Bimini for shade, a stereo, GPS navigation, a swim ladder, and an anchor for sandbar stops. blurb: Anna Maria Island Dolphin Tours offers Egmont Key trips, private and public guided dolphin eco-tours, private and public sunset tours, pontoon boat rentals, and guided jet ski adventures. Wildlife commonly spotted includes dolphins, manatees, sea turtles, eagles, roseate spoonbills, osprey, and other tropical species. Tours and rentals are customized for groups with options for 2-, 3-, or 4-hour tours, shelling trips, and snorkeling to Egmont Key.

quotes.author: Katie
quotes.text: We had Captain Chad. Friendly and knowledgeable. We seen dolphins🐬, manatees and even a shark 🦈 . It was a very relaxing tour and seen wildlife the entire time on the water. I definitely recommend and will book again.

quotes.author: Bridgette Barna
quotes.text: Captain Mike was awesome! We saw dolphins, manatees, manta rays and sharks. Captain Mike had tons of facts about everything we saw and the area in general! 10/10 ️

quotes.author: yajaira campos
quotes.text: Captain Mike took us on the sea to see many dolphins rays sharks and manatees we had a great time,thanks Cap Mike we had a wonderful time.

quotes.author: Gina Bullard
quotes.text: Amazing dolphin tour this morning, we saw tons of dolphins, and a turtle- please request for Captain Mike (very knowledgeable) and FUN.
